title: verify_user_authentication_flow
description: Test the complete user authentication flow including registration, login, password reset, and session management using Supabase Auth to ensure secure access.

title: validate_multi_tenant_data_isolation
description: Verify that multi-tenant support correctly isolates data per tenant and that store setup functions properly to prevent data leakage between tenants.

title: test_product_catalog_crud_operations
description: Ensure that product catalog CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) work correctly and reflect accurately in the sales and product management pages.

title: check_employee_role_and_attendance_management
description: Validate employee management features including role assignment, permission enforcement, and attendance tracking to ensure proper workforce administration.

title: validate_sales_transaction_processing
description: Test sales transaction processing through the POS system including transaction recording and receipt printing to ensure accurate sales management.

title: verify_expense_logging_and_reporting
description: Check that business expenses can be logged, categorized, and retrieved correctly in reporting dashboards for accurate expense management.

title: test_payment_gateway_integration_and_subscription_handling
description: Verify integration with the Duitku payment gateway for subscription payments, renewals, and payment status tracking to ensure seamless billing.

title: validate_internationalization_and_language_switching
description: Test the internationalization features including language selection, dynamic UI translation updates, and correct display of multi-language content.

title: check_theme_toggle_and_persistence
description: Ensure that toggling between dark and light themes updates the UI correctly and that user preferences persist across sessions.

title: verify_protected_routes_and_navigation_flow
description: Test that all navigation flows maintain protected routes, enforce user session validation, and prevent unauthorized access to secure pages.
